patterns.name: Fuzzy autocomplete on brand name and salt composition
patterns.description: Atlas Search autocomplete query with fuzzy matching on brand_name and generic_name fields; returns top 10 suggestions ranked by score; the raw query document is captured and returned to the UI
patterns.pseudocode: db.products.aggregate([ { $search: { index: 'autocomplete_index', compound: { should: [ { autocomplete: { query: userInput, path: 'brand_name', fuzzy: { maxEdits: 1, prefixLength: 2 } } }, { autocomplete: { query: userInput, path: 'generic_name', fuzzy: { maxEdits: 1 } } } ] } } }, { $limit: 10 }, { $project: { brand_name: 1, generic_name: 1, salt_composition: 1, strength: 1, price_INR: 1, prescription_required: 1, score: { $meta: 'searchScore' } } } ])

patterns.name: Faceted search filtered by prescription_required
patterns.description: Atlas Search query combining full-text search with a filter facet on prescription_required boolean; returns paginated results with facet count for OTC vs prescription buckets
patterns.pseudocode: db.products.aggregate([ { $searchMeta: { index: 'autocomplete_index', facet: { operator: { compound: { must: [ { text: { query: userInput, path: ['brand_name', 'generic_name', 'salt_composition'], fuzzy: { maxEdits: 1 } } }, { equals: { path: 'prescription_required', value: filterValue } } ] } }, facets: { prescriptionFacet: { type: 'string', path: 'prescription_required' } } } } }, ... followed by $search with same filters for result documents ])

patterns.name: Generic alternatives via Vector Search with salt+strength pre-filter
patterns.description: Atlas Vector Search using $vectorSearch on description embeddings with a pre-filter restricting results to same salt_composition and strength and is_generic=true; sorted by price_INR ascending; top 5 returned
patterns.pseudocode: db.products.aggregate([ { $vectorSearch: { index: 'vector_index', path: 'vector_embedding', queryVector: targetProductEmbedding, numCandidates: 100, limit: 20, filter: { salt_composition: targetSaltComposition, strength: targetStrength, is_generic: true } } }, { $match: { price_INR: { $lt: targetPriceINR } } }, { $sort: { price_INR: 1 } }, { $limit: 5 }, { $project: { brand_name: 1, generic_name: 1, salt_composition: 1, strength: 1, price_INR: 1, MRP_INR: 1, manufacturer: 1, score: { $meta: 'vectorSearchScore' } } } ])

patterns.name: Top 20 zero-result queries in last 7 days
patterns.description: Aggregation over search_logs to group zero-result entries from the last 7 days by query_text, count occurrences, find most recent timestamp, sort by frequency descending, limit to 20; also computes total distinct zero-result count for ground-truth validation
patterns.pseudocode: db.search_logs.aggregate([ { $match: { result_count: 0, timestamp: { $gte: now_minus_7_days } } }, { $group: { _id: '$query_text', occurrences: { $sum: 1 }, last_seen: { $max: '$timestamp' } } }, { $sort: { occurrences: -1 } }, { $limit: 20 } ])

supporting_indexes.notes: Compound index supports $match on result_count=0 and timestamp range scan
Supports group-by query_text for zero-result queries

patterns.name: Ground-truth zero-result count validation
patterns.description: Simple count query over entire search_logs collection where result_count=0 to produce the absolute ground-truth figure that is compared against the report; the seed manifest constant is cross-checked against this live count
